# Lemonhaze

> Artist working with generative images, texture, and original digital artworks inscribed on Bitcoin. Digital inscriptions are a central medium of the practice.

## Art and collecting
- [Selected Work](https://lemonhaze.com/selected): Selected artworks and series.
- [Collecting](https://lemonhaze.com/collecting): An introduction to original Bitcoin inscriptions, provenance, and inscription-aware custody.
- [Practice](https://lemonhaze.com/practice): Materials, systems, place, and time in the work.
- [About](https://lemonhaze.com/about): Artist background.

## Physical works — preview
- [Print Shop](https://lemonhaze.com/shop): Nine signed Symbiosis prints, limited to three per artwork, and nine original marker-on-textile works. Certificates of authenticity accompany the works. Prices are on request and online purchasing is coming soon. On-chain shop editions are unavailable. Physical purchases are distinct from collecting the original digital inscriptions.
- Frames and room scenes are presentation examples; refer to the product description for what is included.
- Public enquiries: collect@lemonhaze.com.
